Box structure v2: coarse system topology, round 2

One solve over the whole box (h 8, min member 18 mm, 3000 cm³ target, 3.89 kg PETG for the generated material at 1.27 g/cm³, 4.92 kg with the drawn bodies, E), 18 load cases, 79 iterations. Blue = density 0.5 surface; orange = the catch; grey = the receivers. Sheets are cladding (not in the model); the floor is the only support. 3000 cm³ chosen: 2000 cm³ is far too soft (up to 1180 × the full solid), 4000 cm³ is about 2 × stiffer for 1.2 kg more.

Round 2: the structure stands on its own on about 9 cm² of floor (M) and keeps the Overseer bay bodies at 200 long (over the 180 cube).
